entries.title: I Samuel 15:1
segments: ¶And Samuel said to Saul, Jehovah sent *me* to anoint thee king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken to the voice of the words of Jehovah.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:2
segments: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: I have considered what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:3
segments: Now go and smite Amalek, and destroy utterly all that they have, and spare them not, but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:4
segments: And Saul summoned the people, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:5
segments: And Saul came to the city of the Amalekites, and set an ambush in the valley.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:6
segments: And Saul said to the Kenites, Go, depart, and go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them; for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt. And the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:7
segments: And Saul smote Amalek from Havilah as thou comest to Shur, which is opposite to Egypt.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:8
segments: And he took Agag the king of Amalek alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:9
segments: And Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep and oxen, and beasts of the second bearing, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not devote them to destruction; but everything that was mean and weak, that they destroyed utterly.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:10
segments: ¶And the word of Jehovah came to Samuel, saying,

entries.title: I Samuel 15:11
segments: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king; for he is turned away from following me, and hath not fulfilled my words. And Samuel was much grieved; and he cried to Jehovah all night.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:12
segments: And Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning. And it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set him up a monument, and has turned about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:13
segments: And Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, Blessed art thou of Jehovah: I have fulfilled the word of Jehovah.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:14
segments: And Samuel said, What [means] then this bleating of sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of oxen which I hear?

entries.title: I Samuel 15:15
segments: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites, because the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice to Jehovah thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:16
segments: And Samuel said to Saul, Stay, that I may tell thee what Jehovah has said to me this night. And he said to him, Say on.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:17
segments: And Samuel said, Was it not when thou wast little in thine eyes that thou [becamest] the head of the tribes of Israel, and Jehovah anointed thee king over Israel?

entries.title: I Samuel 15:18
segments: And Jehovah sent thee on a way and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:19
segments: Why then didst thou not hearken to the voice of Jehovah, but didst fall upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of Jehovah?

entries.title: I Samuel 15:20
segments: And Saul said to Samuel, I have indeed hearkened to the voice of Jehovah, and have gone the way which Jehovah sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:21
segments: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the choicest of the devoted things, to sacrifice to Jehovah thy God in Gilgal.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:22
segments: And Samuel said, Has Jehovah delight in burnt-offerings and sacrifices, As in hearkening to the voice of Jehovah? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, Attention than the fat of rams.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:23
segments: For rebellion is [as] the sin of divination, And selfwill is [as] iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of Jehovah, He hath also rejected thee from being king.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:24
segments: ¶And Saul said to Samuel, I have sinned, for I have transgressed the commandment of Jehovah, and thy words; for I feared the people, and hearkened to their voice.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:25
segments: And now, I pray thee, forgive my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Jehovah.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:26
segments: And Samuel said to Saul, I will not turn again with thee; for thou hast rejected the word of Jehovah, and Jehovah has rejected thee from being king over Israel.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:27
segments: And as Samuel turned to go away, [Saul] laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:28
segments: Then Samuel said to him, Jehovah has rent the kingdom of Israel from thee to-day, and has given it to thy neighbour, who is better than thou.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:29
segments: And also the Hope of Israel will not lie nor repent; for he is not a man, that he should repent.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:30
segments: And he said, I have sinned; honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship Jehovah thy God.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:31
segments: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped Jehovah.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:32
segments: ¶And Samuel said, Bring ye near to me Agag the king of Amalek. And Agag came to him gaily. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:33
segments: And Samuel said, As thy sword has made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless above women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before Jehovah in Gilgal.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:34
segments: And Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

entries.title: I Samuel 15:35
segments: And Samuel saw Saul no more until the day of his death; for Samuel mourned over Saul; and Jehovah repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.
